left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Stage III periodontitis  [AND] patient having at least one tooth with 2-wall, [OR]  3-wall, [OR]  or combined 2- to 3-wall intraosseous defect  [AND] ≥ 3 mm in depth (assessed by bone sounding, [OR]  radiographic examination) with clinical attachment level (CAL) [AND]  ≥ 5mm and pocket depth (PD) ≥ 6 mm

right.raw_text:
-  Defect not extending to a root furcation area
  -  Vital teeth
  -  Non-smokers

left.raw_text: -  No history of intake of antibiotics  [OR] or other medications affecting the periodontium in the previous 6 months

right.raw_text: -  No periodontal therapy carried out in the past 6 months

left.raw_text: -  Able to sign an informed consent form

right.raw_text: -  Patients age between 25 and 50 years old

left.raw_text: -  Patients who are cooperative, motivated, and hygiene conscious
-  Systemically free according to Cornell Medical Index (Broadbent, 1951)

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Pregnancy  [OR] or breast feeding
  -  The presence of an orthodontic appliance
  -  Teeth mobility greater than grade I
